changes.old: require(all(slot not in manifest.get(t, {}) for t in ('selected_locomotion_sheets','selected_detailed_action_sheets')), 'Selected clip exists: never remake')
changes.new:
require(KEY == 'transform:413' and role == 'run' and direction in ('E','SE','S','SW','W'), 'Only five unapproved held RUN slots are replaceable')
    audit_rel = 'docs/remake/evidence/pr122-mythic-detailed/batch03/mythic413-five-unapproved-run-quality-HOLD-v01-20261020/RUN-five-slot-read-only-audit-v01.json'
    audit_sha = 'b3bec3966c234d87f37b838e10849d1f345d79f72648c72369e789aa4707cee4'
    require(digest(actual_file(ROOT/audit_rel)) == audit_sha, 'Exact independently preserved five-slot HOLD audit required')
    audit = strict_json(ROOT/audit_rel)
    rows = [r for r in audit['slots'] if r['direction'] == direction]
    require(len(rows) == 1 and rows[0]['status'] == 'HOLD_VISUAL', 'One original source visual HOLD required')
    held = rows[0]
    previous_source = audit['source_prefix'] + held['source']
    require(previous_source == 'docs/remake/evidence/pr122-mythic-detailed/batch04/thunder_female-'+direction+'-run-v01.png', 'Only original unapproved v01 source permitted')
    require(manifest.get('selected_locomotion_sheets', {}).get(slot) == previous_source and slot not in manifest.get('selected_detailed_action_sheets', {}), 'Held selected RUN changed; never repeat a replacement')
    old_records = [r for r in manifest['raw_images'] if r.get('source') == previous_source]
    require(len(old_records) == 1 and all(old_records[0].get(k) == v for k,v in dict(key=KEY,direction=direction,role='run',version='v01',production_connected=False,detailed_completed=False,sha256=held['sha256']).items()), 'Original selected source must remain explicitly unapproved')
    replaced_animation = 'run_'+str(advance.staging.importer.DIRECTIONS.index(direction))
    require(replaced_animation in before_tracks and before_tracks[replaced_animation]['source'] == previous_source and before_tracks[replaced_animation]['source_sha256'] == held['sha256'], 'Exact original native RUN track required')
    replacement_pin = dict(source=previous_source,sha256=held['sha256'],audit_path=audit_rel,audit_sha256=audit_sha,before_track_sha256=hashlib.sha256(encode(before_tracks[replaced_animation])).hexdigest())
    require(request.get('corrective_replacement') == replacement_pin and review.get('replacement_review') == replacement_pin, 'Request and independent review must pin the same original unapproved RUN and audit')
    for relative,expected in [(audit_rel,audit_sha),(previous_source,held['sha256']),(str(Path(previous_source).with_suffix('.geometry.json')),held['geometry_sha256']),(audit['source_prefix']+held['request'],held['request_sha256'])]:
        require(digest(actual_file(ROOT/relative)) == expected, 'Held source, geometry, request or audit changed')
        immutable[relative] = expected
    preserved_tracks = {k:v for k,v in before_tracks.items() if k != replaced_animation}
    preserved_frames = {k:v for k,v in before_frame_contract.items() if k != replaced_animation}
    preserved_selections = {t:copy.deepcopy(manifest.get(t,{})) for t in ('selected_locomotion_sheets','selected_detailed_action_sheets')}
    preserved_raw_records = copy.deepcopy(manifest['raw_images'])

changes.old: require(all(current_tracks.get(k) == v for k,v in before_tracks.items()),'Prior native track geometry/pixels changed')
changes.new: require(len(current_tracks) == len(before_tracks) and all(current_tracks.get(k) == v for k,v in preserved_tracks.items()),'Only the single pinned held RUN track may change')

changes.old: require(all(contract.get(k) == v for k,v in before_frame_contract.items()),'Prior playback texture/region/margin/duration/loop/speed changed')
changes.new:
require(set(contract) == set(before_frame_contract) and all(contract.get(k) == v for k,v in preserved_frames.items()),'Other playback texture/region/margin/duration/loop/speed changed')
        cm = strict_json(ROOT/MANIFEST)
        require(cm['raw_images'][:len(preserved_raw_records)] == preserved_raw_records, 'Original raw source history changed')
        for table,original in preserved_selections.items():
            observed = cm.get(table,{})
            require(set(observed) == set(original) and all(observed[k] == v for k,v in original.items() if k != slot), 'Another selected source changed or a slot was added')
        require(cm['selected_locomotion_sheets'][slot] in (previous_source,source_rel.as_posix()), 'Only exact held RUN to reviewed new source replacement allowed')

changes.old: require(actor['native_track_count'] == len(before_tracks)+1 and actor['native_pose_count'] == (len(before_tracks)+1)*6,'Exactly one added clip required')
changes.new: require(actor['native_track_count'] == len(before_tracks) and actor['native_pose_count'] == len(before_tracks)*6,'A RUN replacement must add zero clips and zero poses to existing counts')
